content: Next.js's built-in i18n routing config and middleware are both explicitly unsupported under output: export (official Next.js docs error message 'Specified i18n cannot be used with output: export'; middleware does not run in static export). Community consensus (next-export-i18n package, multiple blog writeups) converges on a client-side-only pattern: a 'use client' React context/hook reading a locale key from localStorage, JSON/TS dictionaries per locale, and updating <html lang> imperatively (same FOUC-avoidance shape as a theme toggle). No package is required to implement this — it is a ~50-line hook + dictionary object pattern.
